question: Third Five Year plans were aimed at making India ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**self-reliant.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Third Five Year Plan** was launched in **1961 **and continued until **1966.**
 
• It aimed at making** India self-reliant **by developing the** country's industrial base** and reducing dependence on **foreign aid**.
 
• The plan focused on the **development of heavy industries**, such as steel, power, and coal, which were essential for the growth of the economy.
 
• It also emphasized the need to** improve agriculture** and** increase food production.**
 
• The Third Five Year Plan was successful in achieving its objectives, and India's economy grew at an **average annual rate of 5.6% **during this period.
 
• The plan also laid the foundation for the** Green Revolution, **which was launched in the** mid-1960s** and helped India become self-sufficient in food production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **An IT nation - This option is **incorrect **as the Third Five Year Plan was launched in the early 1960s, and the concept of IT did not exist at that time.
 
• **Option 3:** Dependent - This option is** incorrect **as the Third Five Year Plan aimed at reducing India's dependence on foreign aid and making the country self-reliant.
 
• **Option 4:** Deficient - This option is** incorrect **as the Third Five Year Plan aimed at developing India's industrial base and improving agriculture to increase food production. The plan was successful in achieving its objectives.
